instruction: Candid medium close-up in a bright indoor room. On the right, the man in the yellow t-shirt (R2) holds the little girl in the light long-sleeve shirt (R1) high up as she hugs his neck. On the left, the woman in the white sleeveless top (R3) has her back to the camera, wrapping her arms around them both in a warm group hug. Soft, natural light illuminates the happy moment.
elements: R2 supports and holds R1 high up
R1 hugs R2's neck while being held
R3 wraps her arms around both R1 and R2 as the outside participant
R3 has her back to the camera while joining the group contact
